people.name: Jericho
people.line: An ancient city in Canaan, famously conquered by Israel

people.name: Jordan
people.line: A river and region, significant in Israel's history

translations.web: The two tribes and the half-tribe have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, toward the sunrise.”
translations.bsb: These two and a half tribes have received their inheritance across the Jordan from Jericho, toward the sunrise.”
translations.kjv: The two tribes and the half tribe have received their inheritance on this side Jordan near Jericho eastward, toward the sunrising.
translations.asv: the two tribes and the half-tribe have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, toward the sunrising.
